unconfirmed.why: Graph path flask.testing.FlaskClient.open -> werkzeug.test.Client.open (also found by text search). Flask only forwards as_tuple when the user passes it (kwargs.pop('as_tuple', None); it is forwarded only if not None), and flask already marks it deprecated for 'Werkzeug 2.1 and Flask 2.1'. Without the parameter, app.test_client().get('/') works on both old and new (returned b'hi'). With c.get('/', as_tuple=True) it passes on old and fails on new with TypeError: EnvironBuilder.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'as_tuple' through flask/testing.py:228. That trigger requires the user to pass the removed parameter, which is not an allowed reproduction, so it is not confirmed.
